A [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a '''soldier''' in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They participated in the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|attempted resettlement]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and was friends with an individual named [[Jessop]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}} As the three aforementioned classes can witness the conversation between [[Unidentified Twi'lek doctor (Taris)|Jessop's doctor]] and his friend in Act I on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], it must therefore take place in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the [[Republic soldier]] asked a [[Unidentified Twi'lek doctor (Taris)|Twi'lek doctor]] about Jessop, who had been bitten by a [[rakghoul]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> a type of [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] that roamed Taris.<ref name="KotOR25">[[Knights of the Old Republic 25|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 25]]</ref> The [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] admitted that they had [[Death/Legends|killed]] Jessop as the latter had been infected with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] and had been in the process of transforming into a rakghoul himself. Jessop's friend then claimed to feel sick, and the doctor offered to take the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] to a grief counselor.<ref name="SWTOR" />

The soldier had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin. They wore the green [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was standard issue for Republic soldiers stationed on Taris. Upon hearing that Jessop had been euthanized, the soldier remarked that they felt ill.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic soldier was created for<ref name="SWTOR" /> the [[2011]]<ref name="Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref> [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. In the game, the soldier appears as a non-player character only identified as "Concerned Soldier."<ref name="SWTOR" />
